observed_problem.surface: Diagnostics → Full Diagnostics → Copy Full Diagnostics Report
observed_problem.symptom: The complete diagnostics report is too large to paste into chat, and Full Diagnostics had no attachable file or ZIP export.
observed_problem.proven_code_gap: The full-report control generated current live diagnostic evidence and passed JSON.stringify(fullDiagnosticReport()) directly to copyText; no Blob, downloadable file, or ZIP path existed.

repair.handoff: Export Full Diagnostics ZIP first runs the existing current live diagnostics evidence path, then packages that exact complete report. A persistent Download Full Diagnostics ZIP link remains available so iPhone Safari can use a direct second tap if the asynchronous evidence run outlives transient user activation.

verification.browser_requirement: A direct click on the prepared persistent link must produce a Playwright download event whose ZIP contains the complete Full Diagnostics report, Whole App Health, export metadata, summary, all eight governed diagnostic sections, and read-only boundary declarations.

claim_ceiling: This receipt certifies the bounded repository Full Diagnostics ZIP handoff and its proof contracts. It does not claim the iPhone handoff is fixed until a fresh post-deployment device test produces and attaches the ZIP.
